message.content:
Checked: The connection pool exhaustion issue in production pgbouncer is resolved by restarting the service. Worker throughput has returned to normal. 

Summary: 
- Ingress idle timeout was increased to stop 502s on the checkout page.
- Internal CA chain intermediate certificate was replaced due to expiration.
- Cron drift issue in container time was identified and noted.
- Failed jobs backlog was due to a bug in job processing logic, which has been fixed and the backlog is moving again.
- Connection pool exhaustion in pgbouncer was resolved by restarting the service.

Recommended next step:
- Monitor pgbouncer connection pool status to prevent future issues.
- Schedule a review of the internal CA chain management process to avoid future certificate expiration issues.
- Document the cron schedule time zone issue and ensure all schedules are reviewed for similar issues.
- Continue monitoring the job processing to ensure no further backlogs occur.

Submitting report...
